summary: Mine the F1 0.5-0.7 dev_golden band for GENERIC cross-site fix patterns

patterns.name: link-and-media-serialization
patterns.description: Emitter: never flatten URLs to bare text inside the selected content flow. Emit as ![alt](src) even when alt="" (derive alt from filename slug: hyphens->spaces, strip -WxH size suffix); resolve lazy images via data-src/data-srcset/data-lazy-src/data-original when src is a data:/1px placeholder; treat imgs with 'attach'/attachment.php URLs as content, synthesizing alt from fieldset legend or nearby label. Emit in-content anchors as [text](href), including file-asset links (.pdf/.doc/uploads paths), button-styled anchors (class~btn), and media iframes (youtube/embed src) as links. Unwrap (do not delete) self-permalink anchors (href==page URL, rel=bookmark) around headlines/.

patterns.name: adjacent-duplicate-dedupe
patterns.description: Emit each text once: (a) drop an img alt/title that equals the immediately adjacent sibling text or a neighboring link to the same href ('Show'+alt'Show', 'Canada Canada', flag/rank badges); (b) collapse consecutive duplicate short lines and emit verbatim-duplicated multi-line blocks (>=200 normalized chars) only once per document (duplicated article containers, browser banners, tooltip/glossary mirrors); (c) drop a leading plain-text line equal to the first emitted H1 (optionally plus a site-name suffix — <title> echo); (d) collapsed-expander dedupe: drop a paragraph ending '(more)' when a later paragraph starts with the same normalized prefix, and drop bare '(more)'/'(less)' toggle lines.

patterns.name: nav-signature-lexicon
patterns.description: Structural/text signatures for nav lines: breadcrumb runs of short link tokens joined by '>'/'>>'/'»'/':' (or elements titled/classed breadcrumb/'Navigation bar'), pipe-separated link rows (>=4 short link tokens joined by '|'), rows of >=5 one-word all-caps links (bold does not exempt), accessibility skip-links ('Skip ... navigation', 'go to page content'), page-action pairs ('Email this page'/'Print this page', 'Back to Article', 'Save | Post a comment'), divs classed page-navigation/page-previous/page-next, and image alts inside pure-nav anchors (href='#', alt starting Skip/Go to/ADVERT, alt ending ' Logo').

patterns.name: repeated-line-family-veto
patterns.description: A short line (<~60 chars) whose exact text recurs >=3 times interleaved across sibling item blocks or once per content section is per-item widget chrome — strip all occurrences ('Cite This Source', 'View Options', 'Report a problem', 'Add comment', 'see more', 'Ocen:'). Extend to skeleton matches where only numbers/usernames vary ('N replies | N view(s)', '<user> is offline', 'Old <date>') and to alt-text families differing only by a trailing index ('... photo 0..15' = thumbnail gallery). Repeated identical headings with empty bodies are the same family.

patterns.name: markdown-shape-emitter-fixes
patterns.description: Emitter hygiene: render h1-h6 inside table cells as bold text (never '####' in a pipe row); when an <li> contains a heading, unwrap the list and emit flat blocks (never nest headings in list items); do not promote styled divs/full-sentence notice paragraphs to headings; never emit emphasis runs wrapping only whitespace (bare '***'); always insert a space/newline between adjacent inline elements so texts never fuse ('bargainingnoun'); demote prose-<pre> (high stopword ratio, few code symbols) to paragraphs instead of a code fence; when a table's first row is a single spanning cell followed by an all-bold/th row, demote the caption row to text and promote row 2 to the header.

patterns.name: content-list-link-density-rescue
patterns.description: Gated exemptions from the link-density/nav veto: (a) a link-only <ul> directly following a kept heading inside the main container is content (FAQ/TOC, tags/keywords/authors/TERMS — data-keyword/rel attrs are strong signals); if it stays pruned, prune the now-orphaned heading too; (b) items with measured-quantity shape (number/fraction+unit before the link, data-ingredient attrs) or substantial per-item prose are content; (c) inline anchors participating in sentence flow (lowercase text adjacent to non-link words/punctuation) never count toward density and are never dropped individually; (d) anchors with empty href='' or single-character text weigh 0; (e) person-card/roster lists (thumb + name-link + 'as <role>') under Cast/Team/Squad headings, nested one-item-per-level inheritance chains, and lists introduced by a retained paragraph ('the links below') are content.

patterns.name: trailing-boilerplate-strip-with-copyright-exception
patterns.description: After the article body (esp. past an end marker/copyright line), strip: paywall/subscription CTA runs (>=3 imperative anchors 'CLICK HERE'/'LOG-IN'/'subscribe'), signup promos ('Register for FREE', 'Join <site>'), legal-disclaimer blocks signposted by Terms of Use/Privacy Policy/'Last Updated:' or ending in a run of dot/pipe-separated policy links, '(Find|View) this article at:' + own URL, mailing-list/render boilerplate ('This archive was generated by hypermail', 'generated in N seconds', 'Received on <date>'). EXCEPTION (charter): rescue plain 'Copyright © <years> ... All rights reserved' sentences and all-caps legal disclaimers even inside pruned footers — copyright lines are content.

patterns.name: hidden-subtree-and-widget-veto
patterns.description: Never emit text that is not rendered: subtrees with inline display:none/visibility:hidden, hide-class vocabulary (hide, hidden, mfp-hide, modal, popup, dialog, tooltip, overlay [with close child], printModal), javascript:-toggled disclosure blocks, onclick-only non-anchor spans/divs (no href), single-char '[X]' close controls, form-label lines whose form was stripped, and CSS/escaped-HTML fragments leaking into text ('selector { prop: value; }', '<div id='). EXCEPTIONS: a display:none section whose adjacent header has paired Show/Hide toggle controls (accordion) is collapsed content — extract it and suppress the toggle labels; modal bodies holding numeric data (nutrition dl/dt) are content.

patterns.name: teaser-rail-strip
patterns.description: Drop related-content rails detected by repeated card skeletons: >=3-5 consecutive sibling blocks each terminated by an identical short link ('More', 'More>>', 'Read more') or a timestamp/counter line (e.g. '^\d\d\.\d\d\.\d\d \d\d:\d\d', '... Reads: [\d,]+'), under headers from {Latest N, Related/Similar Topics, Sponsored links/Content, NEXT/MORE}, especially after the article's end marker or copyright. A heading whose text is a phrase doubled (img alt == adjacent link text) followed by a mid-sentence-truncated excerpt is a teaser card. Must be gated off on listing/archive pages (see homogeneous-sibling-amnesty).

patterns.name: forum-platform-chrome-vocab
patterns.description: Within a post container, strip lines matching the closed vBulletin/phpBB family when >=2 co-occur: {'Reply With Quote', '<name> is offline/online', "<name>'s Avatar", 'iTrader:', 'Join Date:'/'Location:'/'Drives:'/'Bikes:', 'Garage List', 'Appreciate N', 'Old <date>, <time>', '#<n>', 'Mentioned/Tagged/Quoted: N Post(s)', 'Liked N Times in N Posts'}; plus board boilerplate '^It is currently <datetime>$', '^Users browsing this forum:', 'Page N of N', '[ N posts ]', 'Reply to topic', orphan labels ('By:', 'Posted in'), and the underscore-only signature delimiter (cull it and following lines to the post boundary). Gold shape is author+timestamp+body only.

patterns.name: data-markup-keep-signals
patterns.description: Positive keep signals that override layout/link-density pruning: tables with data-table markers (<caption>, <th scope=col>, summary=) even single-column/link-bearing; small 2-column label:value tables (every left cell a short 'Label:' string) and label+value rows inside mixed tables; rows carrying a duration pattern \d{1,2}:\d{2} (track tables) — drop button-only cells, never the row; schema.org microdata (itemprop=datePublished spans on kept headlines, itemscope NewsArticle cards in the main column); and bare text nodes that are direct children of sectioning elements (section/main/div#content).

patterns.name: homogeneous-sibling-amnesty
patterns.description: Keep/drop decisions are made once per structural family: when sibling elements share an identical structural signature (same tag+class family, e.g. article.hentry, teaser-card sets), if any member classifies as content, keep all members — interleaved keep/drop of identical siblings is classifier noise. On archive/term listing pages (short bare-term h1, /tag/ /category/ URL segment) where homogeneous teaser blocks dominate the main region, the teasers ARE the content: suspend 'latest-/spotlight-/related-/block' class-vocabulary pruning for that run.

patterns.name: encoding-and-leak-hygiene
patterns.description: Byte-level repairs before emission: detect charset mis-decoding (high rate of '?' or U+FFFD adjacent to letters where smart punctuation belongs, e.g. 'History?s', 'Fran�ais') and re-decode as cp1252/utf-8; strip BOM and stray GUID/opaque-token lines at document start; never emit entity-escaped HTML tag syntax found in text nodes ('<blockquote class=' as literal text) — treat as noise or re-parse; drop JS page-state stubs ('Please reload this page ...', 'Loading... please wait').
